title: Still life drawing frame
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 2: Still life and a paper bridge (Still Life and Can You Make a Paper Bridge?)
source: Written for art/y2 lesson 6 (Still life drawing frame (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 6: Still life drawing. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

model.title: Draw an apple, a cup and a lemon

parts.text: Shade the side away from the light

box.title: Draw two or three objects from home. Look carefully at their shapes and shading.

keywords.def: a picture of objects that do not move
put things in a place on purpose
when one thing is in front of another

questions.q: Draw a circle, then shade one side of it.
questions.a: A circle with shading on one side

questions.q: Core: Arrange three objects and draw them.
questions.a: A drawing of three objects in their places

questions.q: Extend: Make one object overlap another.
questions.a: One shape drawn partly behind another

questions.q: Stretch: Shade light and dark on every object.
questions.a: Shading on the side away from the light
B) Objects that do not move. Still life means objects that stay still, like fruit and cups.

questions.q: Big question: can a bowl of fruit be a work of art?
questions.a: Yes: artists like Cezanne showed shape, colour and light in fruit
